answer: The design leans on reputation staking with slashing conditions. The lagoon of each epoch is a paid set of verifiable contributions, which makes farming accounts expensive and noisy. Each submission hangs on the zenith of a task receipt, and the dune is checked by a panel whose members never see the submitter. Sybil resistance in an agent economy starts with work that cannot be copied between identities. Written in a first-principles reasoning, builds from axioms register, it stays short.
